## REQ-GEN-001

**Write access and Action calls restricted to authorized participants**

The operator of the Message Bus restricts write access (methods Set and Del) and Action calls (method Call) over the Message Bus to authorized communication participants, e.g. via the ACL of the broker.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: broker, platform
- Refs: MG 3, MG 9, MG 9.2, SF-093
- Verification: d8
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-3-22735921, MG-9.2-a99364df

> Write access and Action calls over the Message Bus must be restricted to authorized communication participants, e.g. via an access control list (ACL) of the MQTT broker (9 Message Bus Communication).
> — MG 3

> To prevent Action calls by unauthorized communication participants, the operator must prevent this via ACL.
> — MG 9.2

Notes: The write access per resource is detailed by REQ-RES-CONFIG, -DATA, -META, -PUBLIST, -REFDES and -SUBLIST ("protected by ACL", reviewed). For Action calls MG 9.2 (Common Services) has the corresponding REQUIRED box since SF-093 was resolved. D8 checks that a client without authorization cannot publish to Set, Del and Call topics.

## REQ-GEN-002

**Pub and Reply under an AppId restricted to that participant**

The operator of the Message Bus should restrict the publications with the methods Pub and Reply under the topics of an AppId to the communication participant identified by that AppId, e.g. via an ACL of the broker that binds the user name or the client certificate of the participant to its AppId.

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Domain: platform · Applies to: broker, platform
- Refs: MG 3, MG 9, SF-119
- Verification: d8
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-3-948bc0f9, MG-9-b9947352

> The publications with the methods `Pub` and `Reply` under the topics of an `AppId` should be restricted to the communication participant identified by that `AppId`, e.g. via an ACL of the MQTT broker that binds the user name or the client certificate of the participant to its `AppId` (9 Message Bus Communication).
> — MG 3

> The operator should restrict the publications with the methods `Pub` and `Reply` under the topics of an `AppId` (`Oi4v2/<ServiceType>/<AppId>/Pub/…` and `Oi4v2/<ServiceType>/<AppId>/Reply/…`) to the communication participant identified by that `AppId`, e.g. via an ACL of the MQTT broker that binds the user name or the client certificate of the participant to its `AppId`.
> — MG 9

Notes: Found in the red team exercise of C-113 (SF-119) and decided as SHOULD by the PO (C-113 D-1): before the application starts, the platform knows its container name, not its full AppId. D8 (T8-BUS-02) checks that a client cannot publish Pub and Reply under the AppId of another participant and warns if it can (no violation).
